review_comments: It seems the other place initializes `callConv` with `(CorInfoCallConvExtension)PlatformDefaultUnmanagedCallingConvention()`, is there a reason we don't do that here?

I believe we want to identify the difference between specifying the default and not specifying a calling convention. This makes a difference for handling inlined P/Invoke stubs (since not specifying one counts as WinAPI)
Ah okay. That is worth a comment as to why the default is different.
